title: Nutritious No-Cook Mediterranean Rest-Meat Bowl
description: A delicious, dairy-free-friendly, no-cook Mediterranean dish featuring rest-meat and v sterbottensost cheese.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced rest-meat, olives, artichoke hearts, and cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Pour the dressing over the rest-meat mixture and toss to combine.
Stir in the chopped parsley and mint.
Transfer the mixture to a mason jar and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the jar a good shake to redistribute the ingredients.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
Note: This dish is best served within a day of preparation, as the flavors will continue to meld and the cheese will soften.
You can also customize this recipe by adding or substituting other ingredients to suit your taste preferences.
For a creamier dressing, feel free to add a tablespoon or two of hummus or Greek yogurt.
For a spicier dressing, add a pinch of red pepper flakes or a minced jalapeño pepper.
